dialog.agent:
I can generate a silent 6-second continuation, but the connected tools can’t extract your clip’s final frame or append new footage to an uploaded clip while preserving the original unchanged. So I can’t deliver that exact 12-second file here.

If you upload the clip’s final frame as an image, I can use it to generate the continuation—she turns and walks out of frame, keeping her appearance as consistent as possible. You’d then need to join the two clips in a video editor.
